ravi_sales: Heads-up: Antares Health POC next week. Buyer wants a single-page capacity plan (reserved vs on-demand), autoscale knobs, and short security answers for procurement. Can SE/Infra/Sec help?

nora_se: Quick traffic sketch from them: baseline ~500 RPS, avg payload ~200 tokens, demo spikes up to 3.5k RPS for ~90s. p99 target <600ms. Also want a quantized variant test.

mike_infra: Proposed baseline: reserve 4 GPUs (A100 equiv), autoscale min=1 max=10 step=2 cooldown=25s, burst credits sized for three 90s spikes (approx 80k tokens). Canary route quantized 8-bit model for cost/quality comparison.

ravi_sales: Budget ask: one-liner percent delta I can paste into RFP?

drew_fin: Ballpark: 4-reserved commit ~30% cheaper than on-demand GPU-hours for sustained usage. Burst credits billed separately; POC bundle can include 150 GPU-hours + burst credit. I'll draft exact numbers.

julia_sec: Procurement wants BYOK, VPC peering, retention windows, and a short PHI handling line. Need one-line answers to drop into the questionnaire.

mike_infra: One-liners: "KMS: BYOK supported (customer-managed keys)", "VPC peering/private link: available for Dedicated/Private", "Retention: configurable 7/30/90/365 days", "PHI: automatic redaction and no-persistent-logs mode available".

nora_se: POC smoke plan (short):
- Day 0: reserve 4 GPUs, enable quantized canary
- Prewarm KV 25m before spikes
- Run three 90s spikes to 3.5k RPS separated by 10m
- Continuous p95/p99 monitoring + token-cost export

mike_infra: Prewarm command we use for presales:
```
redwoodctl prewarm --org antares --prompts top20.json --duration 1500 --parallel 6
```
Schedule 25-30m before the demo window.

julia_sec: Legal asks for a short signed attestation: "Redwood can be configured to not persist raw prompts; PHI redaction available." Mike, can infra sign?

mike_infra: Signed. We'll provide the one-paragraph attestation and SOC2 summary.

drew_fin: I'll post the POC quote (reserved vs on-demand + burst addon + optional day-of extra GPUs) within 8h.

ravi_sales: Perfect—I'll hold sending the RFP response until docs land. Thanks team :rocket: 

prewarm-bot: Prewarm job queued: prewarm-antares-3498765432 (status: queued). Will update on start/complete.
